documents.title: Policy 2:3 Course Syllabus
documents.summary: Univ. Policy 2:3 sets syllabus requirements for all courses. Its only AI content is one sentence asking faculty to include a generative-AI syllabus statement and a promise of university example statements at different levels. It sets no AI stance of its own.
documents.stance_why: The only AI provision says faculty "should include a syllabus statement that outlines expectations for the use of generative artificial intelligence tools", so each instructor decides the rule and the document sets no default; the university only supplies examples "reflecting different levels".

units.why: A university syllabus policy tells instructors to state their generative-AI expectations in the syllabus: "should include a syllabus statement". Addressed to faculty, communicated at course start, so P09; the content of the rule is left to the instructor.
units.anchor: should include a syllabus statement that outlines expectations for the use of generative

units.why: The university commits to supply "example artificial intelligence syllabus statements reflecting different levels of expectation and limitation", i.e. a menu of tiers for instructors. Closest type is P05 (named tiers), but the levels are not named and it is a university support promise, so fit is partial.
units.anchor: example artificial intelligence syllabus statements reflecting different levels of expectation and limitation
units.fit_note: The levels are unnamed and this is a university promise to provide example statements, not a defined set of tiers.
